text: The Patriots-Jets matchup takes on added significance this week with A.J. Brown's status hanging in limbo—while sources indicate the star wide receiver is likely to be activated after missing four games with a right high ankle sprain, head coach Mike Vrabel won't make a final decision until Saturday, and Brown himself acknowledged that his participation remains "still up in the air." Christian Gonzalez, by contrast, is expected to play, giving the secondary some continuity as New England prepares to face a blitz-heavy Jets defense led by Geno Smith, who arrives at Gillette Stadium riding an impressive no-interception streak following the Patriots' dominant 28-point victory last week. Beyond the field, Hunter Henry earned NFLPA Community MVP honors for hosting the second annual "Freedom to Play" ping pong tournament, continuing a week in which Patriot players have dominated the award (Mack Hollins claimed it two weeks prior), while the football world also mourned Jon Morris, the Hall of Famer who spent 11 of his 15 years with the Patriots organization and passed away at 84.
